get.description: Root route. Answers a fixed string, reads nothing and checks nothing — use `/health/live` and `/health/ready` for liveness and readiness.

200.description: Static banner text.

post.description: Public. Opens a session for an existing account. The access token comes back in the body; the refresh token is set only as an `httpOnly`, path-scoped cookie and is never returned in a body. A wrong password and an unknown address answer the same 401, so the route cannot be used to probe which addresses have accounts.

200.description: Session opened. Refresh cookie set on the response.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — Wrong password, unknown address, or a disabled account.

post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Public. Creates the account and opens a session in one call. The access token comes back in the body; the refresh token is set only as an `httpOnly`, path-scoped cookie. The account may still need `POST /auth/complete-profile` before the rest of the API opens up — read `GET /auth/me` to find out.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or a password that fails the policy.

post.description: Public, but the refresh cookie is the credential — this route reads no body and accepts no fallback. Rotates the pair: the old refresh token is revoked, a new one replaces the cookie and a fresh access token comes back in the body. Presenting an access token here fails, and re-using an already-rotated refresh token is treated as replay.

200.description: Pair rotated. New refresh cookie set on the response.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — No refresh cookie, or a token that is expired, revoked, replayed or of the wrong type.

post.description: Public, and deliberately forgiving: clears the refresh cookie and revokes the stored token when one is present, but answers 204 either way so a client can always reach a logged-out state.

204.description: Session closed and cookie cleared. Empty body.

get.description: The account behind the bearer token, with its space and role — the context every other route scopes to. Reachable with an incomplete profile, so a client can read it to decide whether to send the user to `POST /auth/complete-profile` first.

200.description: Current account, space and role.

post.description: Fills in what registration or an invitation left open. One of the few routes reachable with an incomplete profile — every other protected route answers 403 until this succeeds. Re-issues the session afterwards, because the token claims change: a new access token comes back in the body and the refresh cookie is replaced.

200.description: Profile completed and session re-issued.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body.

post.description: Public. Answers 202 with the same acknowledgement whether or not the address has an account — telling the two apart would turn this route into an account-existence oracle. Delivery happens out of band.

202.description: Request accepted. Same answer for an unknown address.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or an email that is not an address.

post.description: Public — the reset token is the credential. Sets the new password and revokes the token. Single-use: replaying it answers 401. Existing sessions are not silently kept alive, so the caller logs in again afterwards.

200.description: Password changed.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or a password that fails the policy.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — Unknown, expired or already-used reset token.

post.description: Public. Answers 202 with the same acknowledgement whether or not the address has an account — telling the two apart would turn this route into an account-existence oracle. Delivery happens out of band.

202.description: Request accepted. Same answer for an unknown address.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or an email that is not an address.

post.description: Public — the magic-link token is the credential, so no password is involved. Opens a session: the access token comes back in the body, the refresh token only as an `httpOnly` path-scoped cookie. Single-use: replaying answers 401.

200.description: Session opened. Refresh token set as a cookie, never in the body.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — Unknown, expired or already-used magic-link token.

post.summary: Log in with a magic link

post.description: Registers a face token against the calling account so it can be used to log in later. Enrollment replaces the previous active identity rather than adding a second one; the replaced record is kept as history, so enrollments stay auditable.

201.description: Identity enrolled and now the active one.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — Missing or invalid bearer token, or the account cannot be used for face login.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

post.description: Public — the face token is the credential, so no password is involved. Opens a session: the access token comes back in the body, the refresh token only as an `httpOnly` path-scoped cookie. An unrecognized face and a disabled account answer the same 401, on purpose.

200.description: Session opened. Refresh token set as a cookie, never in the body.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — Face not recognized, or the account cannot be used.

post.summary: Log in with a face identity

post.description: Admin only. Creates a pending invitation for an email address and hands the invitee a single-use token, delivered out of band. The token is the whole credential — the invitee needs no account first.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or an email that is not an address.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller is not a space admin, or has an incomplete profile.

409.description: `CONFLICT` — That email already belongs to the space, or already has a pending invitation.

post.description: Public — the invitee has no session yet, so the invitation token is the credential. Consumes the token, joins the space and opens a session: the access token comes back in the body, the refresh token only as an `httpOnly` path-scoped cookie. A token is single-use; replaying it answers 401.

200.description: Invitation consumed. Refresh token set as a cookie, never in the body.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED` — Unknown, expired or already-used invitation token.

409.description: `CONFLICT` — The invited account is already a member of the space.

get.description: Public. Answers as long as the process is up and accepting requests. Runs no indicator, so it never fails for a dependency — restart the process when this stops answering.

200.description:
Process is up. Terminus report: `{ status: "ok", info, error, details }`.

The Health Check is successful

503.description: The Health Check is not successful

get.description: Public. Pings the database. Answers whether this instance can serve traffic — the check a load balancer should route on.

200.description:
Database reachable. Terminus report: `{ status: "ok", info, error, details }`.

The Health Check is successful

503.description:
At least one indicator is down. Same Terminus report with `status: "error"`.

The Health Check is not successful

get.description: Public. Short-timeout reachability check against the face-auth detection API. Deliberately separate from `/health/ready`: a degraded upstream is reported here without marking the instance not-ready, because camera and zone management keep working without it. Only person detection stops.

200.description:
Upstream reachable. Terminus report: `{ status: "ok", info, error, details }`.

The Health Check is successful

503.description:
At least one indicator is down. Same Terminus report with `status: "error"`.

The Health Check is not successful

get.description: The DVR the caller space watches, without its password — the stored credential is never returned by any route. Answers 404 while no recorder has been configured yet, which is the normal state of a new space.

200.description: Recorder configuration, password omitted.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — The space has no recorder configured yet.

put.description: Admin only. Stores the recorder the space watches and immediately discovers its channels. Connectivity is tested first and a configuration that cannot be reached is not stored, so a 502 or 504 leaves the previous recorder in place. Discovered channels are reconciled by external id: a channel that comes back keeps its monitor configuration, one that stopped answering becomes `isConfigured: false` rather than being deleted.

200.description: Recorder stored and reconciled. Password omitted.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or a recorder URL that is not usable.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller is not a space admin, or has an incomplete profile.

502.description: `UPSTREAM_ERROR` — The recorder refused the credentials or answered an error. Nothing was stored.

504.description: `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` — The recorder did not answer in time. Nothing was stored.

post.description: Admin only. Answers whether the recorder carried in the body is reachable and accepts the credentials, and writes nothing at all: no configuration, no cameras, not even `lastTestAt`, so a failed probe cannot make the recorder the space already polls look broken. This is the "test connection" button that precedes `PUT /dvr`. The body carries credentials only — a time zone is not part of a connectivity probe and is rejected.

200.description: The recorder answered and accepted the credentials.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, or a recorder URL that is not usable.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller is not a space admin, or has an incomplete profile.

502.description: `UPSTREAM_ERROR` — The recorder refused the credentials or answered an error.

504.description: `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` — The recorder did not answer in time.

post.summary: Test recorder credentials without storing them

post.description: Admin only. Re-runs discovery against the already-stored credentials, so it takes no body. Use it after adding or moving channels on the recorder. Same reconciliation as `PUT /dvr`: matching channels keep their configuration, channels that stopped answering become `isConfigured: false`.

200.description: Discovery finished and cameras reconciled.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller is not a space admin, or has an incomplete profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — The space has no recorder configured yet.

502.description: `UPSTREAM_ERROR` — The recorder refused the stored credentials or answered an error.

504.description: `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` — The recorder did not answer in time.

get.description: Answers the raw image bytes of one stored frame. This is the only route that serves them: snapshots live in the database and are resolved inside the caller space, so another space's id answers 404 rather than the image. Cached `private, max-age=60` — the bytes are per-space and must not be shared.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Snapshot id, taken from a camera read or a capture answer.

200.description: Snapshot bytes. `Content-Type` follows the stored image.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No snapshot with that id in the caller space.

get.description: Every camera discovered on the space recorder, soft-deleted ones excluded. Each carries its discovery fields, its monitor configuration and a derived `latestSnapshotUrl`. A camera the recorder stopped reporting stays in the list with `isConfigured: false` rather than disappearing.

200.description: Cameras of the caller space.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

get.summary: List the cameras of the space

get.description: Full detail for a single camera: discovery fields, monitor configuration and the derived `latestSnapshotUrl`. No recorder URL or credential is on this shape — the recorder is read from `GET /dvr`, and its password never leaves the process.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: The camera.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

put.description: Admin only. Operator-editable fields only — `externalId` and `status` come from discovery and are rejected here. Switching a camera to full-frame monitoring requires an `alertType`, since there are no zones to take the alert level from.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: Camera after the update.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Malformed body, a rejected discovery field, or full-frame monitoring without an alertType.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller is not a space admin, or has an incomplete profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

delete.description: Admin only. Logical delete: the camera leaves every read and the DVR poll list, its alert history is kept. A later discovery run can bring the same channel back.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: Camera removed. Empty body.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller is not a space admin, or has an incomplete profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

get.description: Live view of the polling pipeline for one camera: last poll, last success, last error and its code, upstream latency, and current occupancy per monitored area. Held in memory, so it resets when the process restarts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: Pipeline status: `lastPollAt`, `lastSuccessAt`, `lastErrorCode`, latency and per-area occupancy.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

get.summary: Read the pipeline status of a camera

post.description: Pulls a frame from the recorder immediately instead of waiting for the next poll, stores it, and answers its metadata including the authenticated URL to read the bytes from `GET /snapshots/{id}`. Runs no detection — use `POST /cameras/{id}/analyze` for that.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — The recorder returned a frame over the stored-size limit.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

502.description: `UPSTREAM_ERROR` — The recorder refused the request or answered an error.

504.description: `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` — The recorder did not answer in time.

post.description: Runs the detection pipeline synchronously against an image you upload, as the manual path for when the recorder is unreachable. Answers the detected persons, the per-zone results and any alerts raised; a frame that raises an alert is stored, the rest are not. The upload must be a real image — the magic numbers are checked, not just the declared type — and must fit `SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: Detection result: `persons`, `zoneResults` and the `alerts` raised, if any.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Missing file, a file that is not an image, or one over the size limit.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

409.description: `CONFLICT` — The camera is disabled or has no monitoring configured.

502.description: `UPSTREAM_ERROR` — The detection upstream failed, or its circuit is open.

504.description: `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` — The detection upstream did not answer in time.

get.description: Alerts raised inside the caller space, newest first. Paging is keyset, not offset: send back the `nextCursor` of the previous page, and stop when it comes back `null`. The cursor is opaque — one detection frame writes an event per entered area with the same `detectedAt`, so it carries the event id too and a timestamp of your own will not work in its place. Each item keeps the camera label copied at detection time, so a deleted camera still renders.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on detectedAt, ISO 8601

200.description: One page of history, plus the cursor for the next one.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — A cursor this API did not issue, a `limit` over the ceiling, or a malformed `from`.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

get.summary: Page the alert history of the space

post.description: The inbound webhook for a notification provider. Public: no webhook authentication scheme is chosen yet, so the correlation id issued with the delivery is the only credential, and it is never returned by any other route. The first callback acknowledges the alert; a repeat and an id that matches nothing are answered identically, so the response reveals no event.

202.description: Callback accepted. Same answer for a match, a repeat and an unknown id.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR` — Missing `correlationId`, or one over the maximum token length.

post.summary: Acknowledge an alert from a provider callback

get.description: One alert with the camera label and alert type copied at detection time, the snapshot that raised it if one was stored, and who acknowledged it. History is immutable: logically deleting the camera or the zone it names does not change it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Alert event id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: The alert.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No alert with that id in the caller space.

get.description: One row per channel and recipient the alert was routed to, with its status and the timestamp of any provider callback. Attempts are planned, not yet sent — no provider ships with this API — so they stay `pending`. The correlation id is never in this response: it is what the acknowledgement route accepts, and a member holding it could acknowledge an alert they never received.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Alert event id. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: Delivery attempts planned for that alert.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No alert with that id in the caller space.

get.summary: List the delivery attempts of an alert

get.description: Every rectangle configured on the camera, each with the alert level it raises. An empty list means the camera is either unmonitored or monitored full-frame.

parameters.name: cameraId
parameters.description: Camera the zones belong to. Resolved inside the caller space only.

200.description: Zones of the camera.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND` — No camera with that id in the caller space.

get.summary: List the monitor zones of a camera

post.description: Admin only. Adds one percentage rectangle to a camera. Coordinates are percent of frame, not pixels, so the zone keeps its meaning if the recorder changes resolution. The rectangle must stay inside the frame and have a positive area; a rectangle that does not answers `INVALID_ZONE`.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN` — Caller has not completed their profile.

info.title: Tu Seguridad API
info.description: Space-scoped video surveillance API. Every route outside `auth` and `health` resolves resources inside the caller space, taken from the bearer token, so an id from another space answers 404 rather than a result. Writes that change what the system watches are admin-only. Failures answer `{ statusCode, code, message }` — branch on `code`, not on the message.
